style: Create an original square illustration, a single continuous scenic painting occupying the entire image, never a collage, never panels or icons. Elegant Japanese travel print and hand-printed folk-paper packaging, finely carved ink lines, broad flat luminous colors, subtle ivory paper grain, sophisticated restrained palette, playful but not cute cartoon. Beautiful at small size. No text, lettering, numbers, logos, seals, QR codes, borders, characters or mascots. Especially NO JR logo, NO Iwami town crest, NO Iwamin, NO anime or Free! characters. Avoid near-black large areas; this is for an office color laser printer. It is a poetic composite of real Iwami motifs, not an accurate geographical map. Keep the exact center 20% by 20% of the square visually quiet (water, sand, mist or paving) for a small QR label added separately. Paint continuously under that space: do not draw a blank rectangle. Keep architectural landmarks and crabs OUTSIDE that center. Highest available native resolution. Output an image, not a description.

art.umi/scene: Iwami town, Tottori, Japan: luminous turquoise Uradome Coast, white granite sea stacks crowned by wind-shaped pines in the upper left and upper right, layered ultramarine and jade sea flowing through the middle, sandy beach below. A curved country road leads from the beach to a small old railway station at the lower right: a long low pale cream plaster building, traditional red terracotta tiled half-hipped roof and a small projecting gabled entry porch, no railway logo, all signs blank. Pumpkin vines and one ribbed green kabocha at the lower edge. Tiny hot spring village with wisps of steam among hills in the distance. Coral-orange Matsuba snow crab lying naturally in a fishing basket on a jetty lower left, NOT a giant crab in the sea. One generous composition, breathing space, Japanese woodcut travel art, mineral turquoise, Prussian blue, pine green, coral and warm ivory. View looking across the town and coast. Different scales appropriate to near and far objects.
art.kani/scene: A warm harvest-day panorama at Tajiri fishing harbor in Iwami, Tottori. Foreground lower left: a beautifully articulated Matsuba snow crab with exactly eight long walking legs and two claws lying in a shallow woven fishing basket, russet orange and deep red, beside a ribbed dark-green kabocha and dry pumpkin vines. Middle: quiet harbor water kept pale at the exact center, fishing boats and ropes along its sides. Upper distance: the recognizable white granite pine-topped stacks of Uradome Coast, the small town, red-tiled low cream Iwami Station at the right edge, distant wooded hills and faint hot-spring steam. A continuous landscape and still life, not separate emblems, no snow or blizzard. Rich old Japanese woodblock folk print with vermilion, ochre, midnight-blue thin lines, soft teal sea and generous warm paper light. Absolutely no text, no decorative label panels.
art.eki/scene: Iwami, Tottori: a lyrical autumn journey from Iwai Onsen to Iwami Station and Uradome Coast, represented as one continuous Japanese bird's-eye landscape. Foreground bottom and lower right: the low long pale cream station building with red terracotta tiled half-hipped roof and small gabled porch, pumpkin vines and a green kabocha by the station forecourt. Upper left: an intimate traditional Japanese hot spring street of two-story timber ryokan and tiled roofs among ochre maple hills, modest wisps of steam and a wooden bathing ladle by a stone water basin, not a castle or temple. A winding river and path link the town to a luminous distant sea with white pine-topped granite islands at the upper right. A small fish market crab basket beside the path on the left. Keep exact center quiet pale river mist, do not place a building there. Soft ink-and-gouache Japanese printmaking, terracotta, golden ochre, moss green, pale mineral blue, warm ivory. Detailed purposeful drawing, no logos, no words, no decorative framing. One unbroken large painting.
